title: 选择 Buzz 软件管理界面方向
question: 选定一套视觉语言与首屏结构。所有方案保留原生软件管理操作；差异来自信息层级、排版、密度和状态表达。

options.label: Field Guide Index
options.lineage: Naturalist field guides and specimen indexes
options.thesis: A calm field index makes package identity, version, and state legible at a glance.
options.viewport: Three-column desktop workspace: compact navigation, dense package index, selected package details; installed inventory leads.
options.risk: Can feel like a themed catalogue if specimen language becomes literal.

options.label: Library Accession Index
options.lineage: Modern library catalogues and accession labels
options.thesis: A precise accession index turns a large package catalogue into a fast, trustworthy lookup.
options.viewport: Native-feeling left rail, search-led package table, and a stable detail inspector with source and version metadata.
options.risk: Familiar catalogue structure; distinction must come from unusually clear state and action hierarchy.

options.label: Emission Line Rail
options.thesis: Hairline marks distinguish installed, stale, and upgrade states without flooding the package list with color.
options.viewport: Keep the ordinary package table and details pane; a precise state rail aligns at one edge of every row.
options.risk: An instrument-like screen can obscure the familiar software-catalog task.
options.case: Competitive: unusually clear stale and update states; lower audience fit than the catalogue direction.

options.label: Design Annual Plate Index
options.lineage: Design annuals and technical plate indexes
options.thesis: Quiet paper, one type voice, and precise registration marks keep package metadata composed.
options.viewport: A sober package table with a small accent stamp for selected and actionable rows; detail metadata remains adjacent.
options.risk: Editorial treatment can make actions feel secondary to reading.
options.case: Declined: plate-first composition slows frequent install and update tasks.
options.kept: Keep its restraint: one accent and one type family, with generous alignment.

canonCard.label: macOS Catalog Standard
canonCard.thesis: Polished utility conventions keep every action familiar and predictable.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, search, sortable package list, and a right-hand details inspector.
canonCard.risk: Could look interchangeable with any package manager.
